name: 94102 · San Francisco, CA
findings: ZIP 94102 (San Francisco) has 369 nonprofit organizations. 216 of them (59%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 197 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 94102 (San Francisco) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 94102 (San Francisco) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 7.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 23 organizations here; 12% of all organizations here have no identified type.
